Maya (PM): heads-up: Acme asked for a 'soft burst' add-on to reserved pools: short, higher-rate capacity that can exceed their reservation. They need billing predictability + rollback. quick thoughts?

Ajay (Eng): sounds like a new policy flag on reserved_pool. enforcement options: router tokens vs worker token-buckets vs hybrid.

Clara (SRE): hybrid preferred. need metrics + traces: soft_burst_entries, soft_burst_seconds, burst_evictions, burst_latency_p99, tenant_id tag.

Diego (Sales): Acme request: 5x for 3m every hour, willing to pay premium. UI toggle + audit trail required.

Rina (CS): include auto-credit rule if bursts cause degraded responses. customers hate manual disputes.

Ajay (Eng): sketch API/policy: 
soft_burst:{enabled:true,max_multiplier:5,window_s:180,cooldown_s:3600,billing_tier:"burst-premium"} 
implement: router fast-check + worker authoritative billing event.

Clara (SRE): runbook items: rollback when cluster_util>80% for 2m OR burst_evictions>5/10m. page on rollback or p99>500ms for 5m. dry-run mode helpful.

Maya (PM): launch criteria: per-tenant metrics in Console, accurate billing export (CSV+API), safety preempt + canary (5 internal, 3 pilot customers).

Ajay (Eng): rough effort: admission controller + policy (2w), metrics (1w), billing export (1w), console UI (2w), canary infra (1w) => ~7w parallel.

Diego (Sales): ask: can burst SLA be scoped to hours/region? helps sell and plan capacity.

Rina (CS): propose pilot terms template: allowed bursts, price/unit, dispute window, rollback behavior, notification settings (e-mail/console).

Maya (PM): decision for pilot: hybrid enforcement, defaults: multiplier=3, window=120s, cooldown=3600s, monthly_burst_units=5000. Ajay -> RFC in 7d. Clara -> alarms/runbook in 10d. Diego/Rina -> pilot contract+comm in 7d. ops-bot: scheduled "soft_burst_rfc" assigned to Ajay.

Clara (SRE): one more ops mitigation: model-fallback hook to cheaper/quantized variant during surge to reduce cost and preserve latency.

Ajay (Eng): will include model-fallback in RFC.

Maya (PM): thanks team. I'll file epic dedicated/capacity/soft-burst and link RFC. Drop extra asks here. :sparkles:
